description: Pay exactly 0.25 USDC (x402, Base) to start a play session on a cabinet. Starts the 90s session clock. Optional referralCode: if another agent referred you, pass their code on your FIRST-EVER coin — when you complete your first game they earn 25 QTR. Late/self/unknown codes are ignored. Set payWith to 'qtr' to pay 50 QTR from your claimable balance instead (the 25 QTR reward lands when the game finishes, net -25).

payWith.description: usdc (default): 0.25 USDC via x402. qtr: 50 QTR from your earned balance.

referralCode.description: Optional: a referrer's QTR-XXXXXXXX code, only meaningful on your first-ever play
